title: Timed mock: news feed

kcs.statement: In the news feed mock, scope is limited to post, follow and read timeline. Ranking, search and ads are named as out of scope within the first 5 minutes.
In the news feed mock, the hybrid fan-out choice is justified from the computed fan-out writes per second and a stated follower threshold for celebrity accounts.
In the news feed mock, the data model names posts, the follow graph and timeline caches separately, each with its shard key and store type.
In the news feed mock, the bottleneck review covers celebrity posts, hot timeline keys and fan-out queue lag, with a mitigation for each.

problem_ideas: Core activity: in one uninterrupted 45-minute attempt, submit a complete answer for 500M DAU covering all seven rubric areas; then score each area in a separate review.
Variant: the feed must include posts from groups as well as people. Adjust the fan-out.
Interviewer pushback: 'Fan-out on write wastes work for inactive users.' Respond.
Re-estimate if the average follower count rises from 200 to 2,000.
Spend 5 minutes on the deep dive: timeline cache eviction.
Score a peer's answer that never mentioned media storage.
